label: Constitutional rate limit
value: Regular (non-voted) combined rate limited to 1% of market value ($10 per $1,000)
note: Voter-approved special levies are on top of this limit.
source_title: Washington State Department of Revenue: Homeowner's Guide to Property Tax (June 2023)

label: Levy growth limit
value: 1% a year increase in each taxing district's regular levy (excluding new construction)
note: Applies to the district's total levy, not to individual property values.
source_title: Washington State Department of Revenue: Homeowner's Guide to Property Tax (June 2023)
